wholesale_order_integrity.name: wholesale_order_integrity
wholesale_order_integrity.value: "kind" <> 'WHOLESALE' OR ("wholesale_location_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "distributor_id" IS NULL AND "creator_id" IS NULL AND "creator_commission_bps" = 0 AND "distributor_commission_bps" = 0 AND "discount_kobo" = 0 AND "fulfilment_method" = 'DELIVERY')

metrics_range.name: metrics_range
metrics_range.value: "hydration" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "oiliness" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "sensitivity" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "texture" BETWEEN 0 AND 100

ledger_bucket_owner.name: ledger_bucket_owner
ledger_bucket_owner.value: ("wallet_id" IS NULL AND "bucket" = 'PLATFORM') OR ("wallet_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bucket" IN ('PENDING','AVAILABLE','HELD'))

wallet_exactly_one_owner.name: wallet_exactly_one_owner
wallet_exactly_one_owner.value: ("distributor_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("creator_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

wholesale_price_positive.name: wholesale_price_positive
wholesale_price_positive.value: "unit_price_kobo" > 0 AND "units_per_carton" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND "minimum_cartons" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
